title: Level 1 Demon Lord and One Room Hero
altTitles: Lv1 Maou to One Room Yuusha
Lv1 Demon Lord and One Room Hero
synopsis: After his embarrassing defeat at the hands of a brave hero, the Demon Lord is back and ready for revenge… but after ten years apart, the hero, Max, isn’t the dashing do-gooder the Demon Lord remembers. In fact, Max has turned into a shut-in slob with no interest in an epic rematch. Can the Demon Lord whip his former nemesis back into shape, or will he be defeated by the hero-turned-couch-potato once again and join him in his lazy life?
